542		if strings.TrimSpace(chainID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(blockHash) == "" ||
543			strings.TrimSpace(txHash) == "" {
544			return ReviewHistory{}, errors.New("chainId, blockHash and txHash must be non-empty strings")
545		}
546		if kind != SuppressSandwich && kind != SuppressDisplacement {
547			return ReviewHistory{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %q (want sandwich or displacement)", ErrUnknownKind, kind)
548		}
549		out := ReviewHistory{
550			ChainID:   chainID,
551			BlockHash: blockHash,
552			TxHash:    txHash,
553			Kind:      kind,
554			Status:    ReviewStatusUnreviewed,
555			Version:   0,
556			Original:  nil,
557			Revisions: []ReviewRevision{},
558		}
559		key := conclusionKey{chainID, blockHash, txHash, kind}
560		if _, serr := os.Stat(dir); serr != nil {
561			if errors.Is(serr, os.ErrNotExist) {
562				return out, nil
563			}
564			return ReviewHistory{}, serr
565		}
566		lock, err := lockArchive(dir, syscall.LOCK_SH)
567		if err != nil {
568			return ReviewHistory{}, err
569		}
570		defer lock.Close()
571	
572		data, err := readArchive(dir)
573		if err != nil {
574			return ReviewHistory{}, err
575		}
576		if rec, f, ok := findArchivedConclusion(data, key); ok {
577			out.Original = &ReviewOriginal{
578				BlockNumber: rec.BlockNumber,
579				Finding:     f,
580				Version:     rec.ruleVersion(),
581			}
582		}
583		for i := range data.Reviews {
584			obj := data.Reviews[i]
585			if obj.key() != key {
586				continue
587			}
588			out.Version = len(obj.Revisions)
589			out.Status = currentReviewStatus(obj)
590			out.Revisions = append([]ReviewRevision(nil), obj.Revisions...)
591			break
592		}
593		if out.Revisions == nil {
594			out.Revisions = []ReviewRevision{}
595		}
596		return out, nil
597	}

705	// EvaluateReviews re-judges every archived block on chainID in the inclusive
706	// range [startHeight, endHeight] under the given registered rule version and
707	// compares the candidate conclusions against archived originals, using only
708	// archived evidence and the latest review state. Only original conclusions
709	// marked real or false positive feed the four counts: real risks split into
710	// retained (same tx and same kind still hits; severity changes do not
711	// matter) and missed; false positives split into still hit and eliminated.
712	// A candidate hit on the same tx and kind without a valid (non-withdrawn)
713	// review counts as pending, as does the new kind when the candidate changes
714	// a tx's conclusion type; withdrawn objects behave as unreviewed. The call
715	// is read-only: reports, the enabled version, reviews and alert records are
716	// never modified. An empty range yields zero counts and an empty list. The
717	// named candidate's stored document must still satisfy the registration
718	// rules in full — both rules declared with non-null, well-typed, in-range
719	// parameters, including a rule explicitly disabled (enabled:false) — or the
720	// whole evaluation fails with ErrCorruptVersion before any judgment, even
721	// when the range contains no blocks; the corrupt content is never replaced
722	// by defaults, the currently enabled version or the built-in rules. A
723	// corrupt version the call does not name never blocks an intact candidate.
724	//
725	// Every archived report in the range must likewise still carry an intact
726	// version declaration — the same proof a report query demands, re-validated
727	// from the raw stored document with the parser registrations pass. A
728	// missing or null field or rule object, a wrong type, an out-of-range
729	// number, an unknown field or rule, or a field declared twice in one object
730	// makes the whole evaluation fail with ErrCorruptVersion naming the chain,
731	// the block, the readable saved version id and the offending rule or field
732	// — even when that report has no swaps, no conclusions or no valid review,
733	// and no partial statistics or details are produced. Only an old-format
734	// record with no "version" key at all keeps the built-in interpretation; an
735	// explicit null, an empty object or a partial declaration is corruption,
736	// and an id of "builtin" is validated like any other. A legal declaration
737	// is used exactly as saved: parameters are never completed from the enabled
738	// or a registered version, and the id need not still be registered. A
739	// report outside the chain or range whose declaration alone is damaged
740	// never blocks the evaluation. A failed evaluation changes nothing.
741	func EvaluateReviews(dir, chainID string, startHeight, endHeight uint64, versionID string) (ReviewEvaluation, error) {
742		if strings.TrimSpace(chainID) == "" {
743			return ReviewEvaluation{}, errors.New("chainId must be a non-empty string")
744		}
745		if strings.TrimSpace(versionID) == "" {
746			return ReviewEvaluation{}, errors.New("version id must not be empty")
747		}
748		if startHeight > endHeight {
749			return ReviewEvaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("startHeight %d must not exceed endHeight %d", startHeight, endHeight)
750		}
751		result := ReviewEvaluation{
752			ChainID:     chainID,
753			StartHeight: startHeight,
754			EndHeight:   endHeight,
755			Details:     []ReviewDetail{},
756		}
757		if _, serr := os.Stat(dir); serr != nil {
758			if errors.Is(serr, os.ErrNotExist) {
759				// An absent archive has only the built-in version registered, so
760				// any other id is an unknown version even though the range would
761				// match no blocks.
762				if versionID != BuiltinVersionID {
763					return ReviewEvaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrUnknownVersion, versionID)
764				}
765				result.Version = BuiltinVersion()
766				return result, nil
767			}
768			return ReviewEvaluation{}, serr
769		}
770		// One shared lock for the whole evaluation: the archive snapshot and the
771		// latest review state stay consistent across every block.
772		lock, err := lockArchive(dir, syscall.LOCK_SH)
773		if err != nil {
774			return ReviewEvaluation{}, err
775		}
776		defer lock.Close()
777	
778		// Decode with each record's embedded version declaration and each
779		// registered version kept as its raw stored document, so a wrong-typed
780		// field in one declaration is that report's or that version's
781		// corruption, not whole-archive corruption: the candidate's document is
782		// re-validated from its bytes the same way a single-block comparison
783		// proves its version intact, and every in-range report's declaration is
784		// re-validated from its bytes exactly the way a report query proves it,
785		// rather than decoded into silently zeroed parameters or a
786		// null-explained built-in report.
787		raw, err := readArchiveBytes(dir)
788		if err != nil {
789			return ReviewEvaluation{}, err
790		}
791		var doc rawVersionArchiveDoc
792		if len(raw) > 0 {
793			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
794				return ReviewEvaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("archive is corrupted: %w", err)
795			}
796		}
797		// The requested version must be intact in the archive: re-validate its
798		// stored document before judging anything, so a corrupt version fails
799		// the same way even when the range matches no blocks, has no swaps or
800		// carries no valid manual review.
801		candidate, err := intactVersion(doc.Versions, versionID)
802		if err != nil {
803			return ReviewEvaluation{}, err
804		}
805		result.Version = candidate
806	
807		reviews := make(map[conclusionKey]*ReviewObject, len(doc.Reviews))
808		for i := range doc.Reviews {
809			reviews[doc.Reviews[i].key()] = &doc.Reviews[i]
810		}
811	
812		details := []ReviewDetail{}
813		for _, rec := range doc.Records {
814			if rec.ChainID != chainID {
815				continue
816			}
817			height := uint64(rec.BlockNumber)
818			if height < startHeight || height > endHeight {
819				continue
820			}
821			// Prove the saved declaration before any of the report's conclusions
822			// is judged — and even when none would be. A wholly absent version
823			// key is the only legacy shape and means builtin; every declaration
824			// that was actually written must stand on its own, and a corrupt one
825			// fails the whole evaluation before any statistic or detail is
826			// produced. Reports on other chains or outside the range are never
827			// opened.
828			originalVersion, err := archivedReportVersion(rec.Version)
829			if err != nil {
830				return ReviewEvaluation{}, corruptReportError(chainID, rec.BlockHash, rec.Version, err)
831			}
832			candidateFindings := DetectBlockWithRules(rec.Swaps, candidate.Rules)
833			candByKey := make(map[conclusionKey]ReportFinding, len(candidateFindings))
834			candByTx := make(map[string]ReportFinding, len(candidateFindings))
835			for _, cf := range candidateFindings {
836				candByKey[conclusionKey{rec.ChainID, rec.BlockHash, cf.TxHash, cf.Kind}] = cf
837				candByTx[cf.TxHash] = cf
838			}
839	
840			// Original conclusions: only reviewed (real/false-positive) ones
841			// enter the four counts; same-kind candidate hits without a valid
842			// review are pending; originals that simply vanished without review
843			// are not counted anywhere.
844			for _, of := range rec.Findings {
845				key := conclusionKey{rec.ChainID, rec.BlockHash, of.TxHash, of.Kind}
846				obj := reviews[key]
847				original := &ReviewConclusion{Finding: of, Version: originalVersion}
848				if obj == nil || currentReviewStatus(*obj) == ReviewStatusUnreviewed {
849					if cf, ok := candByKey[key]; ok {
850						details = append(details, ReviewDetail{
851							ChainID: rec.ChainID, BlockHash: rec.BlockHash, BlockNumber: rec.BlockNumber,
852							TxHash: of.TxHash, Kind: of.Kind, Bucket: BucketPending,
853							Original: original, Candidate: &ReviewConclusion{Finding: cf, Version: candidate},
854						})
855					}
856					continue
857				}
858				rev := obj.Revisions[len(obj.Revisions)-1]
859				detail := ReviewDetail{
860					ChainID: rec.ChainID, BlockHash: rec.BlockHash, BlockNumber: rec.BlockNumber,
861					TxHash: of.TxHash, Kind: of.Kind, AppliedRevision: &rev, Original: original,
862				}
863				cf, hit := candByKey[key]
864				if hit {
865					detail.Candidate = &ReviewConclusion{Finding: cf, Version: candidate}
866				}
867				switch rev.Status {
868				case ReviewStatusReal:
869					if hit {
870						detail.Bucket = BucketRetained
871					} else {
872						detail.Bucket = BucketMissed
873					}
874				case ReviewStatusFalsePositive:
875					if hit {
876						detail.Bucket = BucketStillHit
877					} else {
878						detail.Bucket = BucketEliminated
879					}
880				}
881				details = append(details, detail)
882			}
883	
884			// Candidate conclusions whose (tx, kind) matches no original: when
885			// the same tx carried a different original kind this is the "new
886			// type" side of a type change; either way it is unreviewed and
887			// pending.
888			for _, cf := range candidateFindings {
889				if _, sameKind := findOriginalFinding(rec, cf.TxHash, cf.Kind); sameKind {
890					continue
891				}
892				details = append(details, ReviewDetail{
893					ChainID: rec.ChainID, BlockHash: rec.BlockHash, BlockNumber: rec.BlockNumber,
894					TxHash: cf.TxHash, Kind: cf.Kind, Bucket: BucketPending,
895					Original: nil, Candidate: &ReviewConclusion{Finding: cf, Version: candidate},
896				})
897			}
898		}
899	
900		for _, d := range details {
901			switch d.Bucket {
902			case BucketRetained:
903				result.Retained++
904			case BucketMissed:
905				result.Missed++
906			case BucketStillHit:
907				result.StillHit++
908			case BucketEliminated:
909				result.Eliminated++
910			case BucketPending:
911				result.Pending++
912			}
913		}
914		sortReviewDetails(details)
915		result.Details = details
916		return result, nil
917	}

919	func findOriginalFinding(rec evaluateRecord, txHash, kind string) (ReportFinding, bool) {
920		for _, f := range rec.Findings {
921			if f.TxHash == txHash && f.Kind == kind {
922				return f, true
923			}
924		}
925		return ReportFinding{}, false

## 修改内容

**`mevwatch/reviews.go` — `ReviewHistoryQuery` 重写**

原实现用 `readArchive` 把归档整体解码成 `archiveData`：记录内嵌的 `version` 被解码为 `*RuleVersion`，导致 `version:null` 被当成内置规则、缺字段被静默零值化；而且登记版本里一个类型错误的字段会让整个归档解码失败，殃及目标结论完好的历史查询。

新实现与 `report` 查询走同一条证明路径：

- 新增 `reviewHistoryArchiveDoc`：每条记录的版本声明保留为原始字节（`queryRecord`），复核流正常解码，**完全不读登记版本区**——其他区块或登记版本的声明损坏不再妨碍目标查询。
- 命中原结论后，用 `archivedReportVersion`（即 report 查询共用的 `ParseRuleVersion` 完整性校验）从原始字节重新校验该报告保存的版本声明：非空 id、两条规则各有布尔 enabled 和 1—5 整数 severity、位移有 2—100 整数 multiplier；缺失、null、类型错误、越界、未知规则/字段、同对象重复声明（含转义与大小写折叠拼写，即使取值相同）都判损坏。`enabled:false` 且参数完整仍合法；`builtin` id 不免检；只有完全缺失 `version` 键才按旧格式解释为内置规则。
- 损坏时整次查询失败，返回 `corruptReportError`（`ErrCorruptVersion`，指出目标链、区块、可读出的版本标识及有问题的规则/字段），不返回部分历史；CLI 已有 `reviews history` 错误即退出码 1 且 stdout 无输出的路径，无需改动。
- 合法声明按保存的原样使用，不从启用版本或同名登记版本补取，也不要求仍在登记列表；未命中原结论时保持 `original:null`，无复核数据时保持 `unreviewed`/版本 0/空修订；查询只读，不重新检测。
